0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, first in the Northwest and third in the West) host the Washington Wizards (4-5, eighth in the East) in the Thunder's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Oklahoma City on a three-game winning streak and 4-0 at home. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic, and Anthony Davis is a game-time decision after a day-to-day ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet this season, and in the 2025-26 season the Thunder won the series 2-0, most recently 132-111 in Washington on March 21, 2026.
